t: This is the Church of the English Martyrs, a Roman Catholic parish church on Prescot Street, near Tower Hill. It was built between 1873 and 1876 and is Grade II listed. The Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate founded it. The design is by Edward Welby Pugin, son of the Gothic Revival architect Augustus Pugin. Edward died in 1875, before it was finished, and his brothers carried on the work as Pugin and Pugin. By then he had designed more than a hundred Catholic churches, so this is one of a very large body of work.
